title: Trump drops IRS lawsuit, paving the way for a settlement
key_takeaways: The lawsuit was filed in response to the leak of Trump's tax returns, which were published by major news outlets in 2016 and 2017.

Despite these challenges, the lawsuit had the potential to be a major headache for the Biden administration, which could have been forced to spend significant time and resources defending against the lawsuit.

The dropping of the lawsuit may pave the way for a potential settlement, which could allow Trump to avoid the release of sensitive information and avoid a potentially costly and time-consuming legal battle.
